policy.FRQ02-C1: Earn only when the response affirmatively identifies genetic drift or a bottleneck; a negated mention does not earn.
policy.FRQ02-C2: Earn only when randomness or non-selection is explicitly attached to which plants were destroyed/survived, or survivors are explicitly a random sample. Random allele-frequency change after the event is not enough.
policy.FRQ02-C3: Earn when later generations are predicted to have reduced genetic diversity relative to the original population; an initial decrease followed by full recovery does not earn.
policy.FRQ02-C4: Earn for a valid small-population mechanism such as random allele-frequency change, allele loss/fixation, reduced heterozygosity, or failure to restore diversity without mutation/gene flow.
